balls.text: a run-out. Was a yorker from Harshal that Nabi drilled straight back, into the stumps at the other end. The ball ricocheted towards Harshal who picked up and pulled out the stump with the ball in his hands. Nabi was well short
a slower one, full on the stumps. Shepherd swings with the angle but cannot clear Shashank Singh at deep-backward square leg
almost an action replay, the only difference is that Tilak has hit this one towards long-on. Also, the spidercam had changed its location
a yorker that Shepherd digs it out towards long-on
hard length outside off. David looks to hit it down the ground but fails to clear long-off

a slower yorker. David was looking to hit it on the leg side and gets beaten. An appeal for lbw but not given. And the ball races away to the fine leg boundary. Harshal is confident and asks for a review. And the ball tracking shows the impact was outside off. So MI get four leg-byes
a bouncer but way outside off. David was looking for an upper cut but cannot connect

length ball but down the leg side. David was looking to sweep it and misses. Jitesh fumbles and allows another run. Kings have reviewed the wide call and the TV umpire says it was within the batter's reach. So just a bye from that
a slower one outside off. David was standing outside off and waiting for it. Absolutely muscles it over deep midwicket, into the stands
a bouncer and David, even though he didn't look in control, manages to swat it over square leg. There is no one in the deep
a slower one but way, way outside off
length outside off and David smashes it over cover for four

length ball angling away. Goes for the cut and gets beaten. MI have reviewed the non-wide call and they get it changed. A bit harsh on the bowler, I would say as it went under the bat. David was standing outside off
length outside off. Cuts it straight towards cover-point
full on the stumps. Tilak mistimes it towards deep midwicket
a length ball. Hardik goes for the pull but the bottom hand comes off. Brar settles under it and pouches it well inside the boundary line
a short ball. Slapped over extra cover for a couple
a slower length ball around off. Tilak mistimes it uppishly towards long-off
a short ball around off, and it sits up nicely for Tilak to pull it over deep midwicket for a six. Done on the front foot
another full toss, another mis-hit. A single to long-off
a high full toss around off. Tilak goes for the pull but gets an inside edge onto the body. They picked up a single as the ball rolls behind point
too short. Pandya goes back and pulls it over deep midwicket for his first six
a high full toss. Hardik looks to smash it towards deep midwicket but it hits the toe end and goes straight towards Curran who fails to grab it
a low full toss. Flicked towards deep midwicket. 150 comes up for MI
length ball around off. Punched to the left of mid-off where Livingstone makes a diving stop
full and wide. Surya chases it and slices it towards backward point where Prabhsimran Singh, probably the shortest person on the field, leaps up and takes it with both hands
a slower ball outside off. SKY aims for the hoick towards the leg side but misses
Tilak joins the party. Was a short ball, perhaps a slower one, and Tilak pulls it over deep midwicket for a six
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards extra cover
a full toss on the stumps and SKY scoops it over fine leg for a six. It lands in the third tier
Surya makes room, and Rabada follows him with a full ball only to be lofted inside out over wide mid-off for four

An appeal for lbw and given. It was another slower ball, this time on a length around middle stump. SKY looks to pull it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad. Surya wants to review it, and the replay shows it would have just missed the leg stump. So Surya survives
a slower bouncer. Tilak was early into the pull and gets hit on the helmet. They collect a "leg-bye"
full again but within SKY's reach this time who lofts it over extra cover for four

full but way outside off. SKY chases it but fails to connect. And the umpire says it's not a wide. So Arshdeep gets away with it. Wait, there's a late call for the review by Mumbai, and they get the decision changed
a slower length ball. A mistimed pulled towards deep midwicket for one
down the ground and converts this into a full toss. And then hits it through the gap between extra cover and mid-off for another boundary
length ball at the stumps. Tilak backs away and hits it over the bowler's head. Didn't time it to the perfection but got enough on it for a four
a wide yorker. SKY takes it on the full and slices it towards deep cover, with the bottom hand coming off
a slower one. Full and wide outside off. Surya looks to smash it down the ground but fails to connect
length ball angling in. Surya looks to chip it down the ground but it comes from the inner half of the bat. A single to long-on
another bouncer to Tilak, who goes for the pull again but isn't in control this time. Lands safe in front of square, though
goes yorker length. SKY gives himself some room and hits it towards long-on, along the ground but not from the middle of the bat
a bouncer outside off. Pulled down towards deep square leg
slower length ball around off. Goes back and works it towards deep midwicket
length ball around off. Pushed towards mid-off
length outside off. Cuts it in front of point for one
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards wide long-on for two more
full outside off. Pushed to the left of extra cover
length ball on the stumps. Surya gives himself some room and flicks it through midwicket for a couple
length ball angling across. Pushed towards long-off from the back foot
full on the stumps. Pushed towards long-off
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
length ball angling in. Flicked behind square leg

down the track but it's a slower ball from Curran, back of the hand, bowled at 108.1kph. Rohit loses his shape, and the bottom hand comes of the bat as well, as he looks to go over extra cover. Gets an outside edge that goes towards backward point where Brar dives forward to grab it with both hands
full around off, angling across. Rohit goes for the fine sweep and gets an outside edge that ricochets into the grille of the helmet. The physio is out for a quick check
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
length ball at the stumps. Pushed uppishly towards deep midwicket
a yorker. Rohit jams his bat at it and picks up a single as the ball rolls towards cover-point
length ball around off. Pushed towards long-on
a slower ball, full on the stumps. Rohit's bottom hand comes off the handle as he goes aerial, down the ground. Lots of height on it and just enough distance to clear Sam Curran at long-on
short again but way outside off. Rohit lets it go
a yorker. Rohit was making room but can only push it back towards the bowler
another short ball, outside off. Surya swivel and pulls it down towards deep square leg. The single bring up his half-century, off 34 balls. Meanwhile, Rohit has faced only 20 balls
a bouncer but doesn't rise much. Surya pulls it down towards short midwicket
length ball around middle and off. Punched towards long-on
full on the stumps. Pushed to the right of extra cover who makes a diving stop
Use of feet by Surya. Goes down the ground and inside out to launch it over extra cover for a six
full on the stumps. Worked towards deep midwicket
length outside off. Pushed towards cover point
full on the stumps, a legbreak. Driven to long-on
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards wide long-on
Surya finally nails the fine sweep. Full around off from Brar and Surya hits it to the left of short fine leg for four
an appeal for lbw but not given. Was a full ball around off. Surya goes for the fine sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Jitesh caught it but it had bounced before that
full around off. Driven to the left of the bowler for one
full around off. Pushed towards deep extra cover

full around off. Surya sweeps it towards short fine leg where Prabhsimran lets it go through his hands. Rabada makes a diving stop at from deep-backward square leg to stop it just inside the boundary line
a full toss on the stumps. Driven towards long-on
the supla shot! A length ball around off. Surya moves towards the off side a little, lowers his hands and helps it over fine leg for a six
full around off. Surya drives it straight to mid-off
length ball angling in. Surya gets an inside edge between his legs and picks up two to fine leg
almost in the blockhole. Rohit digs it out towards long-on
length ball angling in. Rohit goes for the flick but misses and gets hit on the pad
length ball around off. Surya goes for the fine sweep but ends up playing it straight to the fielder
length ball on the pads. Flicked behind square leg
length ball on the stumps. Pushed to the right of short midwicket for a quick single
full outside off. Swept towards deep-backward square leg once again
length ball on the stumps. Sweeps it towards deep-backward square leg
full around off. Pushed towards extra cover
a slower one but in the slot. Rohit, who was backing away, waited for it to arrive before muscling it over the bowler's head
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg

a loud, loud appeal from Sam Curran. Almost a plea. Kings have decided not to review. Was a length ball that Surya looked to help over short fine leg but misses. The replay shows the ball pitched outside leg stump
length ball at the stumps. Tucked away towards short midwicket
short and wide and Surya needs no second invitation. Was a slower one but it doesn't matter as Surya uppercuts it for four
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards mid-on. Initially Surya was interested in a single but realises there was't one available
length ball around off. Drops it towards point and sets off for a single
length ball angling in. Flicked to the right of midwicket where Brar makes a diving stop to keep it to one

a slower yorker. Bowled from wide of the crease and hits Rohit's front foot. An appeal for lbw and the umpire shows no hesitation in raising the finger. Rohit has opted to review it, after Surya insisted. The only question is whether it's going down the leg side. The ball-tracking shows it would have missed the leg stump. Rohit survives. The Punjab fielders cannot believe this
full outside off. Rohit throws his bat at it with little footwork. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes towards mid-off
length ball around off. Uses his wrists to work it towards deep square leg
starts with a loosener. Full and on the pads. Surya flicks it through midwicket for four
A length ball around off, cramping Rohit for room who pushes it towards cover
an action replay of the last ball. A single to Surya as well
length ball angling onto the pads. Goes for the flick but fails to middle it. A single to backward square leg
a trademark Rohit pull. A length ball outside off, and Rohit pulls it over midwicket with minimum fuss. All the way for a six

Rohit jumps out of his crease. Seeing that, Arshdeep slips in a bouncer. Rohit tries to help it over the slip fielder but makes no contact. Jitesh has a shy at the stumps, to have Rohit diving back, but misses
length ball around off. Surya presents the full face of the bat and picks up a single to mid-off
full outside off. Surya looks to repeat the flick from earlier in the over but fails to middle it. A single to fine leg
short of length angling in. Extra bounce as well. But Surya does well to chop it down to the right of short third where a casual effort by Harshal lets it go for four
length ball angling in. Surya lets it come to him and lifts it over midwicket to open his account
length ball around off. Defended towards extra cover
a length ball around off. Surya mistimes it into the ground

and he strikes first ball. No celebration from Rabada, only a laugh as he knows this was not a wicket ball. It was short and wide. Kishan went after it but didn't middle it. Brar at deep third wasn't exactly at the edge of the boundary line but he times his jump well to grab it with both hands
Arshdeep pulls his length back and beats the outside edge as the ball goes with the angle. Rohit was looking to defend on the front foot
full around off. Rohit moves across a touch and uses his wrists to flick it through mid-on for the second four of the over
short and wide. Kishan goes for the cut again but this time he hits it straight towards deep point
short of length outside off and Kishan throws his bat at it. Gets a thick outside edge that goes over the slip fielder for four
length ball on the stumps. Worked behind square leg
length outside off. Kishan cuts it hard but Brar at cover dives to his right to make a partial stop. Might have hurt his finger, though, on the left hand
Full outside off. Rohit leans into the drive and hits it through covers for four. Still a good over for Kings, I would say
length outside off. Goes back and drags it towards wide long-on
length ball around off. Punched to extra cover. Brar there
full on the stumps. Rohit helps it behind square leg
length outside off. Goes back and works it towards wide long-on. Mumbai are off the mark
full and wide, and spinning away. Kishan leaves it alone

Full and wide outside off again, Rabada walks to the off side and crunches it through point. A flat throw but has Rabada made it? Nope. It is all over. Kishan does well to collect and disturb the stumps with Rabada inches out. Mumbai escape to a win! Ooof! Nabi with the rocket through from the deep
Full and wide, but it is outside the tramline. He will have to re-bowl that
Full and outside leg, Rabada backs away and hits it to long-on
Connects the pull and Mullanpur gets its voice again. Short ball, off-pace, Rabada gets good hold of that and hits it well over deep square leg

Nonchalance? Nooooo! Finds Nabi on the fence! Sounded so good, looked like Brar connected. Length ball on middle, he moved across and played the pick-up shot over the on side. Unfortunately for him and Kings, found the fielder at deep backward square leg
Backs away and carves a fullish ball over point, gets two as a result
Yorker just down leg, Brar moves inside the line and misses the flick. Wide not given and PBKS review. The batter moved and hence the on-field call stays
Slower length ball on leg, nudged through midwicket off the inner half. He hadn't timed it well and that allowed him to come back for two
Slower bouncer now, Harshal backs away to slash but once again is done in
Another bumper, he hops and looks to upper but misses
Back of a length outside off, Coetzee is bowling proper fire, 149.4kph, Harshal could only make contact with thin air
Another short ball, 150kph, Brar goes for the heave but gets hit on the hips. He starts late for the run, backward point has a shy but misses at the bowler's end
Length ball on the stumps, pushes it towards cover and runs with the shot

And the plan pays off for Mumbai! Is that the telling blow? Can they believe again? Third, fine leg, square leg and midwicket were out for the shot for the short ball, apart from long-on. Coetzee runs in and bowls it short but rolls his fingers over it. Ashutosh goes for the pull and hits it straight to Nabi, who is in from the ropes. Coetzee roars, but is it enough to silence Kings' roars?
Length ball on the stumps, Brar keeps it out. That was the main objective of Kings, and they have been successful in that
Back of a length outside off, looks to upper cut it but misses
Another bumper, well directed, around off, Brar ducks, 140 kph
Back of a length outside off, he sways back and glides it to deep third who is straighter this time. Coetzee was all over the place while fielding it but ensures it does not pass him

Short ball, Brar is caught by surprise again. Looks to crouch and fend it away but gets hit on the right glove. Gets it to the on side and runs to the other end. Bumrah asks him if he is fine, while walking back to his mark
Slower one, full outside off, 120.9kph, pushed towards cover

Brar says, don't forget me! Gets a ball in his slot just outside off, clears his front le and deposits it high and long straight over the bowler's head. 24 off the over, and good night, Mumbai Indians?
Length ball in line of the stumps, he goes for the heave across but is early into the stroke. Gets it to the off side and steals a leg-bye. 117.2kph
Over the wicket, sparys it full and down leg
Ashutosh Benjamin de Villiers! Expects a full ball. Gets one outside leg. Takes his left leg to the on side to open up his stands and just reverse-scoops it over third. Crazy batting this

Cracking stroke to bring up a 23-ball 50! Mid-off is up, so he knew the line and length that Madhwal was going to bowl. Backs away and gets under a full ball to thump it over long-off. And the siren goes off, meaning, Madhwal has overstepped
Yorker on leg, he clears his front leg and hits it back to the bowler. Madhwal stayed around the wicket and bowled that at 136.6kph
Brar looks to get across and play the scoop to the length ball at 136kph but gets an edge towards short third
Another full and wide ball attempted, goes just outside the guide line. Hardik asks Kishan if it is indeed wide and does not review
Full and wide, just inside the tramline, he backs away to hit through off but misses
Full and wide outside off from around the stumps, Brar does not reach that. Wide given
Slower one outside off, Ashutosh cannot get bat to that
Ashutosh still finds the boundary! Poor ball though. A juicy full toss on the thigh, he gets inside the line and helps it fine down leg, Too fine for fine leg
Pulled to fine leg

Dropped? Looks like that going by the reactions. Digs it into the surface at 149.1kph, Brar goes for the pull but gets it off the toe end back towards the bowler. Coetzee does get down in his follow-through but the ball hits his left wrist

Fortunate edge and Coetzee throws his head back in disappointment. Once again full and angling away, he goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge. Deep third is quite wide and cannot get around
Just over cover. Full and slanting away outside off, 137.7kph, Brar lofts it over the leaping man in the ring
Full outside off, driven to cover
Length ball angling in, he goes for the flick but misses.
Back of a length angling in, punched back towards the bowler
Full toss on middle, knocked down to long-on
Very full on off, driven to mid-off
Sounded good, looked very, very good! Shepherd lands it on a back of a length at 116.1kph. Ashutosh sits deep in the crease and wallops it over deep square leg
Hangs back to the length ball, pats it to the on side and keeps strike

What a shot! Ashutosh knows he has outsmarted the bowler and has a wide smile on his face. Anticipates a yorker, gets it, he slog sweeps it over backward square leg for half a dozen. Where was this guy all these years?
Length ball outside off, steered to short third. And Bumrah has overstepped
Very full on off, driven back. Bumrah gets his right hand out and stops it in his follow-through
Yorker on off, manages to knock it down to long-on
A sharp bouncer on middle and leg to start, Brar takes evasive action

And Bumrah answers Mumbai's call! Once again. The sheer dependability of this guy. My goodness. Starts off with a slower one - but the batter does not pick it, in the slot. Shashank thinks this one is there to be deposited straight over. Goes for the big shot and only skies it high up. Tilak runs in from short midwicket and takes it next to the pitch. What a bowler Bumrah is!
Full and outside off, guided to short third
Once again tries to repeat the shot by backing away, he misses and gets to the other end, thanks to the inside edge

A swipe that goes the distance! Off-pace length ball on middle and leg, Ashutosh stands still, only slightly crouches and sends it sailing over fine leg
.
Charges down early and nudges the length ball through midwicket
Slower one on a length outside off, opens the face to get it through point
Full on off, driven back down the ground. Hardik stretches his right leg to try and stop that, like in that World Cup game...
Back of a length outside off, he goes for the reverse hoick but misses
What a hit! Stands tall and whips it a la a helicopter shot. Teasingly flying over dep square leg. It was a length ball just outside off, just what Ashu wanted
Full on off, drilled to cover
Full on off, eased through point, it was played with soft hands and that allows him to come back for two
Short, wide, punished. Ashutosh stands tall and slashes it wide of backward point
Back of a length slower one outside off, 102.8kph, Shashank walks down the track and cracks the eave to deep midwicket
Full toss on off, 137.9kph, crunched to sweeper cover
Soars into the fine leg stands! A hit-me ball and Ashutosh obliges. Length ball down leg, harmless, he lifts it well over the ropes
Length ball on off, eased down to long-on
Yorker on off, squeezed out to the off side for one

Plumb lbw! Or so it seems. Jitesh opts to review. A full toss on middle and leg, Jitesh misses the flick and also falls over a touch. Perhaps surprised by the pace and height at which it arrived. Hits him below the knee roll on the front pad. Is it sliding down? Umpire's call on hitting the stumps
Dropped but a real tough chance. Full ball around off, Shashank drives it back on the up. Madhwal had just completed his action and cops a blow on his left thumb and the ball goes to the on side
Flatter on middle, whipped to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, 94.1kph, punched to long-off
Goes back and punches this to long-off

Did not seem to make a good noise that. But it has gone the distance. Shreyas bowls it on a length on middle, 94kph. Perhaps he anticipated the charge down the track. But Shashank stays deep in the crease and heaves it aerially. Lands on the boundary cushions on the full, between deep midwicket and long-on
Bang! Straight into the sightscreen Gets a flighted ball in the slot, clears his front leg and deposits it over the ropes
On the stumps, swept to deep backward square leg
Length ball on middle, turned through midwicket
Not off the meat but well enough. Backs away early, Hardik follows him with a length ball, off-pace. Jitesh manages to get under it and lift it over extra cover
Length ball on the stumps, pushes this towards mid-off on the walk and gets to the other end
Fuller and once again down leg, he moves inside the line to flick but misses
Length ball slidiing down leg, he misses the swish
Length ball on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg
On a length outside off, defended towards backward point
Another bouncer, well above the batter's head this time. Wide for height given
Short ball just outside off, 135.9kph, Jitesh sways away from the line
Fuller on off, driven through extra cover to keep strike
Soft dismissal. Googly on a length, Bhatia goes back to punch it down to long-on but ends up chipping it back. Shreyas dives to his left and takes that
Goes back to the length ball that spins away, punched through cover
Flatter and shorter around off, punched past the bowler
Flatter and quicker on middle, he goes back and turns it across to the on side
Welcomed with a maximum! Shreyas starts with a half-tracker on middle at 90.2kph, Shashank stands tall and wallops it over deep midwicket
Just around good length, on middle and leg, 131.3kph, defende back towards the bowler. Four dots in a row to end the powerplay
A bit of shape into Bhatia as he lands it on a length on middle and leg, 133.8kph, whipped towards mid-on, losing his balance a touch
Leading edge as he looks to turn the length ball on middle and leg across, lands short of short cover running in
Length on off, defended to the on side, 140.9kph
Length ball outside off, patted to the off side for a quick run
Sees Shashank backing away, and follows him with a length ball at 139.7kph. He is forced to defend it to the bowler
Inside edge, and beats short fine leg. Outside off on a length, Bhatia looks to encash on the width. Ends up getting it just past off stump and wide to Bumrah's left
Length ball nipping back in from outside off, he gets it off the inner half towards Bumrah at short fine leg, where he misfields and parries it towards deep square leg
Length ball just outside off, tapped it to the off side for a quick one
swinging away on a length, he goes after it with a slash but misses
Up and over! Almost goes the distance. Length ball just outside off, moving away a touch, Shashank is on the move down the track and lofts it over extra cover
Beats the bat first up! Back of a length just outside off, 134.7kph, his hands follow the path of the ball but fortunately he does not nick that
Pinpoint yorker on middle and leg, Bhatia does superbly well to dig that out. It was bowled at 130.4kph, he brought down his bat in time
Very full outside off, digs it out towards cover for a quick run
Sprays it way down leg, Kishan dives full stretch to stop that
Short and outside off, Bhatia rides the bounce and pulls it towards midwicket
Length ball outside off, gets a soft inside edge on the bounce to the wicketkeeper
Flicked fine. Length ball on middle and leg, sliding on the pads. Bhatia does well to get enough bat on that to get it fine of fine leg
Length ball on the fifth stump, he takes a small stride forward and lifts his bat
Now Shashank uses the bowler's pace to collect four! Back of a length, width outside off on offer, 151.6kph. He hangs back and slashes hard to beat backward point
Back of a length, angling in, once again rushes Bhatia in the pull. Gets a top edge over the circle at backward square leg
On a length outside off, punchd to backward point
Back of a length at 146kph, just outside off, glided to deep third
Length ball outside off, swinging further away. Shashank goes for the slash but misses. Kishan leaps to his right and pouches that. Wide given
Back of a length on off, punched back defensively to the bowler. 148.7kph

Caught Coetzee, bowled Coetzee and Mumbai's celebrations continue. He takes a few steps forward to his left in his follow-through and takes a good, low catch to end Livingstone's night. Back of a length around off, rushed Livi for pace. He goes for the pull but ends up getting it back towards the bowler off the cue end. 150kph

Appeal from Kishan. A belated one. But Bumrah is quite convinced. Or is it about the ball brushing something? Wide given and Mumbai have reviewed. Fullish and angling in from around the stumps, Curran is on the back foot and looks to flick it away. Snicko returns a spike and Bumrah has two in the over! What a start. And he was the only one who seem to be certain about the nick. A feather of an edge and Mumbai have rattled the Kings
Another yorker outside off, the inswinging one this time, Livingstone opens the face and ges it past the diving backward point

BOOM, BOOM Bumrah! A perfect inswinging yorker to make a mess of Rossouw's stumps. He was expecting a length ball and was sitting in the crease. But the freak of the fast bowler in Bumrah just spears it full and straight on off and middle and gets it to swing in a touch. Booom!
Length ball around off, taps it to the off side and sprints to the other end
Spears this full on the pads, swings in a touch, Curran misses the flick. The impact was outside leg
Starts with a length ball, angling away, 129.7kph, defended towards point
Fuller on middle and leg, defended back towards the bowler
Full and outside off, slashed to deep third
Direct hit and he could have been in trouble. Pushes the fullish ball towards mid-off and takes on Hardik, and makes it with a dive because the throw was slightly wide

Flying Kishan in Mullanpur! Moves to his left and dives full length to pouch that. Coetzee is pumped up after an erratic start. Slants this into Prabhsimran on a length. He looks to swivel and pull but only gets a glove. The wicketkeeper does not miss and Mumbai are on the board.
Back of a length angling in, he looks to tuck it away but gets it off the body to the on side
Sprays this well down leg for five wides. No chance for Kishan to get around.
And Curran gets the perfect start for Kings! Stands tall, in the crease, gets a length ball outside off that he punches off the meat. Beats cover and four to get going
